title: Strange message colors when sensor age exceeds 10 days
symptom: When sensor age exceeds 10 days, the message changes to 'Expires Sun, 3:58pm' with white text on a cream background, which is almost illegible. The user asks if this is the rule or if they chose wrong colors in settings.
cause: The problem was caused by the phone's MIUI 14 OS, specifically the screen display setting 'Dark' caused the issue, while 'Clear' worked fine.
fix: Change the phone's screen display setting from 'Dark' to 'Clear'.
evidence_quote: I just found that this was a problem caused by my phone's MIUI 14 OS, just like the strange color settings problem in discussion #3176, i.e. if the screen display setting is "Dark", problems exist, if "Clear" all is OK.
